units.title: SG-6.4.3 · Wire approve, retry and reject handlers into AdminApp's ExecutionPanel
Act: Add execution action handlers to AdminApp
Act: Show execution action failures through actionError
Verify: AdminApp execution handlers call the client and reload unit tests

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Retry POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then it POSTs the retry with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution for the current round; When the user clicks Retry; Then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/retry is sent with Authorization 'Bearer secret' and the executions list is fetched again

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Approve POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then it POSTs the approval with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution; When the user clicks Approve; Then POST .../approve is sent with 'Bearer secret' and the executions list is reloaded

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Reject POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then it POSTs the rejection with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution; When the user clicks Reject; Then POST .../reject is sent with 'Bearer secret' and the executions list is reloaded

tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > 500 shows server message in alert
tests.title: Given a FAILED execution, when the retry endpoint returns 500 with {error:"boom"}, then the Execution region shows "boom" in an alert
tests.scenario: Given a retry endpoint answering 500 with a JSON error; When Retry is clicked; Then the Execution region shows 'boom' in an alert

tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > 401 shows Invalid token gate
tests.title: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the approve endpoint returns 401, then the admin token field is shown again with "Invalid token"
tests.scenario: Given an approve endpoint answering 401; When Approve is clicked; Then the token gate reappears with 'Invalid token'

tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > successful action clears earlier error
tests.title: Given a failed action, when the next action succeeds, then the earlier error message is gone
tests.scenario: Given a first retry returning 500 and a second retry succeeding; When Retry is clicked again; Then the earlier error alert is no longer shown

tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > non-Error rejection shows Request failed
tests.title: Given a FAILED execution, when fetch rejects with a non-Error value, then the Execution region shows "Request failed"
tests.scenario: Given a retry request rejecting with a plain string; When Retry is clicked; Then the Execution region shows 'Request failed'

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Retry POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Retry on a FAILED execution POSTs the retry with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/retry is sent with Authorization 'Bearer secret' and GET /api/v1/admin/executions is called again
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Approve POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Approve on an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution POSTs the approval with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/approve is sent with Authorization 'Bearer secret' and GET /api/v1/admin/executions is called again
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers > Reject POSTs with admin token and reloads
tests.title: Reject on an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution POSTs the rejection with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/reject is sent with Authorization 'Bearer secret' and GET /api/v1/admin/executions is called again
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: AdminApp execution action error display unit tests

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution handlers > retry POST
tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers: Retry POSTs with token and reloads
tests.title: Retry POSTs the retry with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then it POSTs the retry with the admin token and reloads the executions

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution handlers > approve POST
tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers: Approve POSTs with token and reloads
tests.title: Approve POSTs the approval with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then it POSTs the approval with the admin token and reloads the executions

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution handlers > reject POST
tests.name: AdminApp execution handlers: Reject POSTs with token and reloads
tests.title: Reject POSTs the rejection with the admin token and reloads the executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then it POSTs the rejection with the admin token and reloads the executions

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution action errors > 500 boom
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors: retry 500 shows server message in alert
tests.title: Shows the server's error message in an alert when the retry endpoint returns 500
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution whose retry endpoint answers 500 with {error:"boom"}, then the Execution region shows "boom" in an alert

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution action errors > 401 token gate
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors: approve 401 returns to token gate
tests.title: Shows the token field again with 'Invalid token' when the approve endpoint returns 401
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution whose approve endpoint returns 401, then the 'Admin token' field is shown again with 'Invalid token'

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution action errors > error cleared on next success
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors: earlier error cleared after a successful retry
tests.title: Clears the earlier action error once the next action succeeds
tests.scenario: Given a first retry that fails with 500 and a second retry that succeeds, then the earlier error message is no longer shown

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx > AdminApp execution action errors > non-Error rejection
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors: non-Error rejection shows generic message
tests.title: Shows 'Request failed' when fetch rejects with a non-Error value
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution whose retry request rejects with a plain string, then the Execution region shows "Request failed"

attempts.failure: Verify tests failed (1): AdminApp execution action errors > retry 500 with {error:'boom'} shows 'boom' in Execution region alert

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx::retry 500 JSON error shows message in Execution alert
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > retry 500 with {error:'boom'} shows 'boom' in Execution region alert
tests.title: The Execution region shows the server's 'boom' error message in an alert when retry returns 500
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, when the retry endpoint returns 500 with {error:'boom'}, then the Execution region shows 'boom' in an alert
tests.detail: Expected alerts to contain 'boom'; actual alert text is '500 ' because readJSON in src/api/client.ts ignores the JSON error body. Implementation fix needed in Act.

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx::approve 401 shows token gate with Invalid token
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > approve 401 shows Admin token field again with 'Invalid token'
tests.title: The admin token field is shown again with 'Invalid token' when approve returns 401
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when the approve endpoint returns 401, then the 'Admin token' field is shown with 'Invalid token'

tests.id: adminActions.test.tsx::earlier error cleared after next successful action
tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > a failed action followed by a successful one clears the earlier message
tests.title: The earlier action error message is gone after a later action succeeds
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution whose first retry returns 500 and second succeeds, when the user retries again, then the earlier error message is no longer shown

tests.name: AdminApp execution action errors > fetch rejecting with a non-Error value shows 'Request failed'
tests.title: The Execution region shows 'Request failed' when the action request rejects with a non-Error value
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, when fetch rejects with a non-Error value, then the Execution region shows 'Request failed'
